text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO alert - p99 tail latency spike on production model-serving cluster. p99=2200ms (SLO=1200ms). Affected: /v1/generate (streaming). Paging eng-oncall.
maya: ack. I'm taking this. :eyes:
maya: quick check - is this global or region-specific? metrics look noisy from us-west-2 first.
sam: seeing same in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 but us-west-2 is worst. p95 up to 800ms, p99 2200ms.
maya: pulling kv-cache metrics now. eviction_rate spiked ~5x in last 20m, slab_utilization up to 94% on some shards.
alex: could be fragmentation - we saw similar when prefill bursts outpaced decode workers.
maya: yep, prefill:decode ratio jumped to ~3.2:1 around 17:02. decode worker CPU at 98% on hot pods.
jamie: streaming stalls are showing long gaps in token delivery, looks like KV miss + decode queue backlog.
opsbot: runbook: KV_CACHE_PRESSURE -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-pressure
maya: following runbook. Step 1: reduce prefill concurrency for low-priority tenants. Step 2: scale decode replicas. Step 3: if pressure persists, temporarily route some traffic to fallback model-compact.
sam: I'm going to throttle prefill for tenant group 'alpha' (low priority) via feature flag.
maya: do it. flag key: `prefill.alpha.concurrency` set 0.3
sam: done. set `prefill.alpha.concurrency=0.3` -> feature-flags svc ok.
maya: scaling decode deployment now (scale from 6 -> 10)
sam: run:
```
kubectl scale deployment/decoder-worker -n prod --replicas=10
``` 
sam: scaling started, pods coming up.
alex: while pods spin up, let's temporarily increase KV eviction aggressiveness to free small fragments. We'll adjust `cache.eviction.window_ms` from 60000 -> 30000.
jamie: caution - aggressive eviction can increase cold-decode load. But given backlog, net win.
maya: applied change via configmap update and restarted cache-proxy on 3 hot nodes.
```
kubectl rollout restart sts/kv-cache-proxy -n prod
``` 
maya: also ran compaction job for slab allocator on shard-12 (hot): `/usr/local/bin/kv-compact --shard=12 --max-run=30s` logged some frees.
sam: monitoring metrics... eviction_rate trending down, slab_free_chunks increasing.
alex: decode queue length dropping as new decoders become ready. p95 trending down to ~420ms.
jamie: user-impact check: support queue shows 14 new streaming timeouts over last 30m, mostly from alpha tenants. Not widespread yet.
maya: routing mitigation: moved 10% traffic from model-serving-prod -> model-serving-fallback (compact quant) to reduce peak token decode cost.
```
curl -XPOST https://routing.internal/set -d '{"route":[{"from":"/v1/generate","to":"/v1/generate-compact","percent":10}]}'
```
opsbot: noted incident tag `kv-frag-1753333333`, creating incident channel /inc/kv-frag-1753333333
sam: after throttling prefill + scale + eviction tweak + routing, p99 dropped to ~950ms at 17:40.
maya: nice. continue to monitor for 30m. if stable, we'll hand off to next oncall for watch and do postmortem.
alex: temporary mitigations: rollback routing and eviction once cache stabilized; follow-up: evaluate prefill rate limiters and slab compaction scheduler.
jamie: customer impact summary: ~2% of streaming requests saw stalls/timeouts for ~20-40m window. No broad request loss. Key customers A and C filed tickets.
maya: creating a quick follow-up doc: `/docs/incidents/kv-fragmentation-1753333333.md` with timeline & mitigations.
opsbot: created incident doc skeleton and linked support tickets: TICKET-4891, TICKET-4892
sam: I'm going to stay on watch for next 45m, then handoff to alex at 18:30.
maya: agreed. assign handoff to alex in 2hrs. add checklist to postmortem: - prefill backpressure improvements - slab compaction cadence - split of decode/predecode resource pools - smarter routing fallbacks
alex: noted. I'll run a heap/profile on decoder pods tomorrow to see if we can improve decode throughput.
maya: closing page (no longer paging) but keeping monitor channel open. :white_check_mark:
sam: thanks all. great triage.
alex: one more: add alert for prefill:decode ratio >2.0 to catch earlier.
jamie: adding to alerting board now.
opsbot: incident status updated -> mitigated. p99 back to 900ms, p95 380ms. Next: postmortem in 48h.
maya: logging final metrics snapshot and attaching to incident doc.
maya: handing off to alex at 18:30 as planned. leaving notes in thread.
